blocks.text: SpaceX 的数据中心和 Grok 智能体在今年第二季度的盈利超出投资者预期，该公司正逐渐摆脱其太空公司的根基，转而专注于人工智能，目前人工智能已占其收入的 52%。

inlines.text: SpaceX 的数据中心和 Grok 智能体在今年第二季度的盈利超出投资者预期，该公司正逐渐摆脱其太空公司的根基，转而专注于人工智能，目前人工智能已占其收入的 52%。

blocks.text: 根据其监管文件，埃隆·马斯克旗下这家庞大的企业集团周二公布第三季度营收为 146 亿美元。这一数字得益于所有业务板块的增长，尤其是其更名为“超级智能”的业务线，该业务线包括最近收购的 Cursor 编程工具、Grok 机器人，以及最重要的、如今拥有 1.7 GW 算力的蓬勃发展的新云业务。

blocks.text: 这一数字还因约 10 亿美元与比特币价格回升相关的收入以及一笔未具体说明的关联方收入而得到提振，后者可能归因于 SpaceX 对另一家公司的投资。

blocks.text: 收入增长的同时，总资本支出达到 196 亿美元，因为 SpaceX 继续建设其第二个数据中心项目 Colossus II，并加大对 Starship 的投资——该公司认为这枚重型运载火箭对于部署新一代 Starlink 卫星和开发轨道数据中心至关重要。

blocks.text: 尽管有这些资本支出，该公司的收入增长仍足以将其重新推回盈利状态。SpaceX 报告净利润为 44 亿美元，较去年同期的 10 亿美元亏损实现扭亏为盈。

blocks.text: SpaceX’s data centers and Grok agents have been more profitable than investors expected in second quarter of the year, as the company leaves its roots as a space company behind to focus on artificial intelligence, which now makes up 52% of its income.

inlines.text: SpaceX’s data centers and Grok agents have been more profitable than investors expected in second quarter of the year, as the company leaves its roots as a space company behind to focus on artificial intelligence, which now makes up 52% of its income.

blocks.text: Elon Musk’s deep conglomerate reported on Tuesday $14.6 billion in third-quarter revenue, according to its regulatory filing. That number was driven by growth in all segments, but especially it’s renamed “Super Intelligence” business line, which includes the recently-acquired Cursor coding tool, Grok bot, and most importantly, the company’s burgeoning neocloud business, which now boasts 1.7 GW of compute.

inlines.text: Elon Musk’s deep conglomerate reported on Tuesday $14.6 billion in third-quarter revenue, according to its
regulatory filing

. That number was driven by growth in all segments, but especially it’s renamed “Super Intelligence” business line, which includes the recently-acquired Cursor coding tool, Grok bot, and most importantly, the company’s burgeoning neocloud business, which now boasts 1.7 GW of compute.

blocks.text: That number was also boosted by about $1 billion in income related to the recovery of bitcoin prices and an unspecified related-party income that might be attributed to a SpaceX investment in another company.

inlines.text: That number was also boosted by about $1 billion in income related to the recovery of bitcoin prices and an unspecified related-party income that might be attributed to a SpaceX investment in another company.

blocks.text: The growing revenue is balanced against total capital expenditures of $19.6 billion, as SpaceX continues to build out a second data center project, Colossus II, and increase investment in Starship, the heavy lift rocket it sees as vital to deploying a new generation of Starlink satellites and developing orbital data centers.

inlines.text: The growing revenue is balanced against total capital expenditures of $19.6 billion, as SpaceX continues to build out a second data center project, Colossus II, and increase investment in Starship, the heavy lift rocket it sees as vital to deploying a new generation of Starlink satellites and developing orbital data centers.

blocks.text: In spite of those capital expenditures, the company’s revenue boost was substantial enough to push it back into profitability. SpaceX reported net income of $4.4 billion, a turnaround from the $1 billion loss in the same quarter last year.
